name: JL_CL_AP_WHT_CERTIFICATES_ALL
description: JL_CL_AP_WHT_CERTIFICATES_ALL contains all necessary information to issue withholding certificates. It also stores the original certificate number and its status that allows reprinting capability. Its records are inserted by a server side program and retrieved during the certificate printing.

columns.name: CERTIFICATE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier to the certificates.

columns.name: CERTIFICATE_NUMBER
columns.description: Certificate number generated by system.

columns.name: CERTIFICATE_YEAR
columns.description: The year applied to the certificate.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the General Ledger set of books associated with the certificate record.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier for the transaction.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the supplier associated to the payables transaction.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates certificate status. P=Preliminary, F=Final, R=Reprinted.

columns.name: PARTICIPATION_FLAG
columns.description: To identify certificates that are 'Professional Service Fee' or 'Professional Service and Participation Fee'. If it is 'Y', the certificate contains 'Professional Service and Participation Fee'.

columns.name: TAX_PAYER_NUMBER
columns.description: A unique reference number which is used to identify entities for tax-related purpose.

columns.name: REPRINT_DATE
columns.description: Reprint date of last certificate.

columns.name: SERVICE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Stores the total professional service fee invoice amount for each supplier, certificate year, set of books and organization.

columns.name: PARTICIPATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Stores the total professional service and participation fee invoice amount for each supplier, certificate year, set of books and organization.

columns.name: TAX_AMT
columns.description: Stores the total withholding tax amount for each supplier, certificate year, set of books and organization.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
